item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Captain Post
item.content:encoded:
Greenlit by Scorpion451 and cybersqyd

Author, if you're referring to the thread here: http://www.scpwiki.com/forum/t-13858748/greg it doesn't look like you received any greenlights.

Reviewers will be very clear when they are giving greenlights, often using bolded and/or colored text. Neither reviewers in your thread have done so.

item.title: JS Staff Post -- Forum Crit -- Info
item.content:encoded:
Author,

As per the How to use this forum thread at the top of this forum:

If you're a first-time author, remember to provide a direct link to/information for your two greenlights!

If you have not yet received greenlights, please proceed to the ideas forum and follow the guidelines set in the required reading.

Thank you.
